name: Machine Pullover
instructions: Adjust the seat so your shoulders line up with the machine's pivot, then sit back and place your arms on the pads overhead.
Pull the pads down and forward in an arc until your arms reach your torso, driving with your elbows.
Return slowly to the stretched position without letting the weight stack touch down.
Keep your back against the pad.
image_prompt_scene: Seated in the pullover machine with the arms overhead on the pads.
